subject: Sprint-gate procurement orchestration for Dedicated Onramp
messages:
From: Julia Summers <julia.summers@oemtech.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme.ai
Date: 2027-12-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: OEM quote + lead-time options for OGX-4800 tranches

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks for the call earlier — attaching the formal quote for the OGX-4800 skus we discussed. Two options are shown: (A) standard manufacturing queue (16-20 week lead time) and (B) expedited gated production (8-10 week lead time) with a 20% expedite surcharge and a non-refundable 10% binding deposit to secure the initial tranche.

We noted your tranche plan: 40% initial ship (pilot/validation), 30% second tranche, 30% final. OEM can commit to partial shipping lanes if we receive a confirmed schedule and the deposit for tranche 1.

Attachments: OEM_Quote_OGX-4800.pdf

Let me know if you need the quote broken down by customs-eligible SKUs or if PioneerAI requires branded packing/ETA holdback clauses. Happy to draft a conditional ship amendment for DocuSign.

Best,
Julia Summers
Strategic Accounts — OEM Tech

From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: julia.summers@oemtech.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-03T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: OEM quote + lead-time options for OGX-4800 tranches

Julia — thanks, received and reviewed. A few clarifying items from our side as we align this to the PioneerAI deal: 

1) Can you confirm partial-ship packaging/testing support for the first tranche (we need a subset of nodes preloaded with our runtime image for on-site acceptance tests).
2) Are there latitude windows for pushing a tranche forward by 2–4 weeks without re-qualifying the expedited surcharge?
3) We need clear incoterms for customs handling — ideally DDP to avoid PioneerAI customs hold risk.

On Redwood side: Ben, Karthik — we plan to propose a blended procurement posture: OEM expedited for tranche 1 to hit the early customer pilot, with cloud backstop for production-smoothing. I want to lock the MAP (mutual action plan) milestones so OEM, cloud, and PioneerAI have one schedule.

Action: Julia — could you produce a one-page amendment showing partial-ship commitments and a DocuSign-ready expedite option? Target: draft by 2027-12-06 so we can include in the deal playbook.

Thanks — Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Dedicated Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: julia.summers@oemtech.com
Date: 2027-12-06T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: OEM quote + lead-time options for OGX-4800 tranches

All — quick note on the cloud backstop and commercial guardrails:

- Supply_ops (Galaxy Cloud) has tentatively held a burst pool for PioneerAI: 200 inferencing GPUs for 12 weeks as a temporary backstop, subject to a signed T&C and a committed usage estimate. If we elect to use cloud capacity to cover the 2–6 week gap between tranche 1 and tranche 2, we should: 1) lock the Cloud_Backstop_T&Cs.docx and 2) carve a billing pass-through in the MAP so PioneerAI sees a single line item.
- Cost trade: cloud burst will be ~2.5x unit cost vs owned GPU amortized — acceptable for <8 weeks but not longer.
- Ops: We must ensure image parity (runtime + quantization) for the preloaded nodes; Julia — OEM to confirm we can have factory-flash images with our runtime image hash.

I'll draft the MAP workbook (MAP_Dedicated-Onramp.xlsx) and a short escalation play for delayed customs/QA.

Ben Carter
Head of Solutions, Redwood Dedicated

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: julia.summers@oemtech.com, logan_wright@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-09T08:37:00Z
Subject: Re: OEM quote + lead-time options for OGX-4800 tranches

Julia / Team — procurement constraints from our side to make the committed dates contract-ready: 

- We require a firm lead-time SLA per tranche with a +/- week tolerance and a cure clause for outside-window failures.
- Deposit schedule we can accept: 10% non-refundable for tranche 1 to secure expedited production; 40% due at tranche 2 ship order; balance on final shipment acceptance.
- Acceptance tests: Redwood + PioneerAI will run on-site validation (48–72 hours) for tranche 1 hardware; OEM must enable factory flash of the agreed image and provide handoff checklist.
- Customs & insurance: DDP preferred; if OEM cannot, we need a named customs broker and insurance certificate on ship.

Please consolidate these into the amendment. Also, include an optional clause allowing Redwood to convert up to 25% of the final tranche to cloud credits if manufacturing slippage exceeds 6 weeks. That gives us a contractual fallback.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Julia Summers <julia.summers@oemtech.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-18T15:22:00Z
Subject: RE: OEM quote + lead-time options for OGX-4800 tranches

Team — attaching the amendment and a DocuSign packet that reflects: expedited tranche 1 (8–10 weeks), 10% deposit, factory-flash support for Redwood image, DDP where available, and an optional cloud-conversion clause (25%) if slippage >6 weeks. OEM accepts the acceptance test window and will provide the handoff checklist.

Attachments: OEM_Quote_OGX-4800.pdf; MAP_Dedicated-Onramp.xlsx; Cloud_Backstop_T&Cs.docx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/console/documents/abc123-sign

Next steps: Logan — if this looks good we ask PioneerAI for contract sign-off and will schedule tranche 1 build slot pending deposit receipt. Julia says OEM can push an initial partial ship earlier by prioritizing the staging pool for those pre-flashed nodes if deposit clears within 72 hours of signature.

Best,
Julia Summers
Strategic Accounts — OEM Tech
